summary: dellemc.enterprise_sonic breaking changes to sonic_aaa, sonic_bgp_communities (aann moved under members as a list), sonic_route_maps (set ip_next_hop becomes a dict) and a new sonic_vlan_mapping argspec for SONiC 4.2+.
questions: Why do my sonic_vlan_mapping playbooks fail on SONiC 4.2?
What changed in sonic_route_maps set ip_next_hop?

answer_card.title: dellemc.enterprise_sonic breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `sonic_aaa`: updated to align with SONiC functionality.
- `sonic_bgp_communities`: `aann` is now a suboption of `members` and is a **list of strings**.
- `sonic_route_maps`: `set ip_next_hop` changed from a single-line option to a **dictionary**.
- `sonic_vlan_mapping`: new resource module argspec; playbooks written for SONiC 4.1 must be revised for SONiC 4.2+.
